# SOP-P3-L2-05 Planned shutdown - Ring Rolling line

Revision: Rev B  
Plant: P3, line P3-L2  
Equipment: EQ-P3-L2-SB01, EQ-P3-L2-RR02, EQ-P3-L2-HT03  
Related documents: ECN-2026-044, MM-P3-L2-SB01, SB-1015

1. Purpose and scope  
   1.1 Purpose: Execute a planned shutdown of the Ring Rolling line to perform inspection, lubrication, and maintenance on EQ-P3-L2-SB01, EQ-P3-L2-RR02, and EQ-P3-L2-HT03.  
   1.2 Scope: Applies to technicians and maintenance personnel assigned to P3-L2.

2. Preconditions (must be verified before shutdown)  
   2.1 Obtain authorization per ECN-2026-044.  
   2.2 Confirm production hold scheduled by Line Control.  
   2.3 Verify availability of maintenance materials per MM-P3-L2-SB01.  
   2.4 Ensure shot blast cabinet isolation valve and lockout procedures are available per SB-1015.

3. PPE required  
   3.1 Safety glasses, steel-toe boots, hearing protection, cut-resistant gloves, and flame-resistant coveralls.  
   3.2 Respiratory protection when entering enclosures where particulate control is not confirmed.

4. Shutdown and isolation sequence (stepwise)  
   4.1 Stop feed and allow machines to come to rest.  
   4.2 Lock out and tag out main electrical supplies for EQ-P3-L2-SB01, EQ-P3-L2-RR02, EQ-P3-L2-HT03.  
   4.3 Verify zero energy at all lockout points before entry.  
   4.4 Bleed and lock pneumatic and hydraulic lines where applicable.  
   4.5 Drain residual materials from relevant housings per MM-P3-L2-SB01.

5. Lubrication instructions (use exact part numbers)  
   5.1 The lubricant part number for Ring Rolling radial ring rolling mill #2 (EQ-P3-L2-RR02) is CFW-LUB-930.  
   5.2 The lubricant part number for Ring Rolling shot blast cabinet #1 (EQ-P3-L2-SB01) is CFW-LUB-463.  
   5.3 Apply lubricants only after surfaces are cleaned and manufacturer guidelines in MM-P3-L2-SB01 are followed.

6. Inspection and corrective actions  
   6.1 Inspect bearings, belts, guards, and sensors; document findings.  
   6.2 Record required corrective actions and reference ECN-2026-044 for engineering changes.

7. Recommissioning and handover  
   7.1 Remove locks and tags only after verifying all tools and personnel are clear.  
   7.2 Perform controlled restart and functional check.  
   7.3 Log restart in line control system.

8. Sign-off (required)  
   Operator: ____________________  Date: __________  
   Maintenance lead: ____________________  Date: __________  
   Engineering approval (if required per ECN-2026-044): ____________________  Date: __________
